summary: A member gets up to fetch a child’s ball and comes back to the unfinished discussion.
realLife: Vogelsinger remembered Caroline interrupting her father’s outdoor labor-bill meeting to play.
gates: A child is present during work at home.
inGame: needs: a family interruption tied to the place and time of a bill briefing.

turns.what: Another adult joins the child outdoors and the member finishes the discussion.
turns.pulledBy: The other adult is free and the briefing is nearly over.
turns.writesBack: The meeting ends before the member goes outside.

turns.what: The member puts the papers away and resumes the discussion after supper.
turns.pulledBy: The child needs more time and the advisers can stay.
turns.writesBack: The briefing notes carry a second session that evening.
